query: How will we standardize for changing test mix, pandemic workflow shifts, and new instruments across 2021–2023, and which ITS or segmented-regression strategies will we pre-specify to quantify changes?

response.query: How will we standardize for changing test mix, pandemic workflow shifts, and new instruments across 2021–2023, and which ITS or segmented-regression strategies will we pre-specify to quantify changes?
response.answer: To standardize for changes, ITS and segmented-regression strategies will quantify shifts. Pre-specification of these methods will ensure accurate adjustments for test mix, pandemic workflow, and new instruments. This approach will be applied consistently across 2021–2023.
